{
  "hypotheses": [
    {
      "text": "Data‑artifact: Tesla files both 10‑K and 10‑Q reports, and some filings use the legacy 'Revenues' concept while others use the newer 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' concept, leading to both concepts appearing in the dataset.",
      "how_to_test": "SELECT cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept, COUNT(*) AS filings
FROM edgar.revenue_facts
WHERE cik = 1318605
GROUP BY cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept;"
    },
    {
      "text": "Real‑world: Tesla adopted ASC 606 (Revenue from Contracts with Customers) effective FY2018. Before adoption it reported total revenue using the legacy 'Revenues' concept; after adoption it began reporting under the ASC 606‑specific concept, while still retaining the legacy concept for comparability or for certain regulatory filings.",
      "how_to_test": "SELECT fiscal_year,
       SUM(CASE WHEN concept = 'Revenues' THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END) AS rev_legacy,
       SUM(CASE WHEN concept = 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END) AS rev_asc606
FROM edgar.revenue_facts
WHERE cik = 1318605
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year;"
    },
    {
      "text": "Data‑artifact: Tagging/extension errors cause some periods to have duplicate facts with both concepts for the same accession_number (i.e., the same filing incorrectly tags the same numeric value under two concepts).",
      "how_to_test": "SELECT accession_number, period_start, period_end,
       COUNT(DISTINCT concept) AS distinct_concepts
FROM edgar.revenue_facts
WHERE cik = 1318605
GROUP BY accession_number, period_start, period_end
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT concept) > 1
LIMIT 10;"
    },
    {
      "text": "Real‑world: The two concepts represent different measurement bases – 'Revenues' includes gross sales while 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' excludes assessed taxes (e.g., sales tax). Tesla may report both to provide users with gross and net‑of‑tax views.",
      "how_to_test": "SELECT fiscal_year,
       AVG(CASE WHEN concept = 'Revenues' THEN value_usd END) AS avg_gross,
       AVG(CASE WHEN concept = 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' THEN value_usd END) AS avg_net_tax
FROM edgar.revenue_facts
WHERE cik = 1318605
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year;"
    },
    {
      "text": "Data‑artifact: Coverage gap – the XBRL taxonomy did not include the 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' concept until after 2017, so earlier years only have the legacy concept; later years have both because filers continue to tag the legacy concept for backward compatibility.",
      "how_to_test": "SELECT MIN(fiscal_year) AS first_year_legacy,
       MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' THEN fiscal_year END) AS first_year_asc606
FROM edgar.revenue_facts
WHERE cik = 1318605;"
    }
  ]
}
